title: About Us

paragraph1.text: is an extension of the da'wah efforts of the An-Naba Al-Azhim Foundation in Makkah, dedicated to spreading the values of the Qur'an.

paragraph2: The idea of establishing this center in Indonesia arose from an urgent need to reconnect the Muslim community with the Qur'an—not just in terms of recitation and memorization, but through deeper understanding and practice.
